page.content:
Successor security organization born from the wartime alliance.

How United Nations connects

  • Faction: Allies — The UN was built to keep the wartime Allies in a permanent body.
  • Work: Atlantic Charter — The Charter's language fed the later United Nations.
  • Event: Yalta Conference — Yalta locked in big-power voting that shaped the UN Security Council.

What is United Nations?

The United Nations grew from the 1942 Declaration by United Nations and the 1945 San Francisco Conference. It was designed to hold the wartime coalition in a permanent security council.

Key threads lead to Allies, Atlantic Charter and Yalta Conference.
